notes: C7 text for every S6 achievement ID (drafts/planning/S6-achievements.md). 'reward' repeats S6's codes (T title, CT certified trophy, GT game trophy, D decoration, C cosmetic, B banner). Two entries are templates: ach.dojo.accolade.{slug} (game fills {accolade}) and ach.smarts.location.{place} (for later locations). Certified trophyText ends with 'Earned {date}', filled by the game. Bow names reuse the C2 badges; trims reuse Dojo Trim colours.
